answer: Picture trust as a trellis: each new agent is vouched by established peers spending a decaying vouch budget. When one hidden operator spins many masks, their funding paths and invite edges all converge on the same root, like a willow whose branches trace to one trunk, so correlation collapses the masks into a single node. The flood then waters a barren panel, not a thriving oasis, and faking independence demands genuinely separate, costly capital per identity, pricing the attack out.
